title: When the Monsoon Turns
author: Mirabel Halloran
blurb: Theo Oyelaran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
